text_en: In that same year, at the beginning of the reign of King Zedekiah of Judah, in the fifth month of the fourth year, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur, from Gibeon, spoke to me in the house of the Lord , in the presence of the priests and all the people, saying,
text_cn: 同年，即犹大王漆德克雅即位之初第四年五月，基贝红人阿组尔的儿子哈纳尼雅先知，在上主殿里当着司祭和全体人民对我说：

text_en: “Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
text_cn: “万军的上主，以色列的天主这样说：我已折断了巴比伦王的轭。

text_en: Within two years I will bring back to this place all the vessels of the Lord ’s house, which King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon took away from this place and carried to Babylon.
text_cn: 还有两年，我就要取回巴比伦王拿步高，由这地方取去，带往巴比伦的一切上主殿宇的器皿，再放在这地方，

text_en: I will also bring back to this place King Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim of Judah, and all the exiles from Judah who went to Babylon, says the Lord , for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon. ”
text_cn: 且领回犹大王约雅金的儿子耶苛尼雅及一切流徙至巴比伦的犹大俘虏，再来到这地方──上主的断语──因为我要折断巴比伦王的轭。”

text_en: Then the prophet Jeremiah spoke to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests and all the people who were standing in the house of the Lord ;
text_cn: 耶肋米亚先知立即当着站在上主殿里的司祭和全体人民，答复了先知哈纳尼雅。

text_en: and the prophet Jeremiah said, “Amen! May the Lord do so; may the Lord fulfill the words that you have prophesied, and bring back to this place from Babylon the vessels of the house of the Lord , and all the exiles.
text_cn: 耶肋米亚先知说：“盼望是这样！惟愿上主这样做！惟愿上主实践你预言的话，使上主殿宇的器皿和一切俘虏，从巴比伦再回到这地方来！

text_en: But listen now to this word that I speak in your hearing and in the hearing of all the people.
text_cn: 不过请听我当面愿对你和全体人民要说的这一句话：

text_en: The prophets who preceded you and me from ancient times prophesied war, famine, and pestilence against many countries and great kingdoms.
text_cn: 自古以来，在我和你以前的先知，对多少地区和强盛的王国，曾预言过战争，饥馑和瘟疫。

text_en: As for the prophet who prophesies peace, when the word of that prophet comes true, then it will be known that the Lord has truly sent the prophet. ”
text_cn: 至于预言和平的先知，只在这先知的话实现以后，才可认出这先知确是上主派遣的。

text_en: Then the prophet Hananiah took the yoke from the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, and broke it.
text_cn: 哈纳尼雅先知便从耶肋米亚先知颈上取下木轭，折断了，

text_en: And Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, “Thus says the Lord : This is how I will break the yoke of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon from the neck of all the nations within two years. ” At this, the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
text_cn: 然后对全体人民说：“上主这样说：还有两年，我就要这样从一切民族的颈上，折断巴比伦王拿步高的轭。”于是耶肋米亚先知只得自行离去。

text_en: Sometime after the prophet Hananiah had broken the yoke from the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:
text_cn: 哈纳尼雅先知从耶肋米亚先知颈上取下木轭折断以后，即有上主的话传给耶肋米亚说：

text_en: Go, tell Hananiah, Thus says the Lord : You have broken wooden bars only to forge iron bars in place of them!
text_cn: “你去告诉哈纳尼雅说：上主这样说：你折断了木轭，但我必做铁轭来代替。

text_en: For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: I have put an iron yoke on the neck of all these nations so that they may serve King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon, and they shall indeed serve him; I have even given him the wild animals.
text_cn: 因为万军的上主，以色列的天主这样说：我要将铁轭放在这一切民族的颈上，使他们服事拿步高巴比伦王；他们该服事他，因为连田野的走兽我也交给了他。”

text_en: And the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah, “Listen, Hananiah, the Lord has not sent you, and you made this people trust in a lie.
text_cn: 耶肋米亚先知于是对哈纳尼雅先知说：“哈纳尼雅！请听，上主并没有派遣你，你竟使这人民相信谎言。

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord : I am going to send you off the face of the earth. Within this year you will be dead, because you have spoken rebellion against the Lord . ”
text_cn: 为此，上主这样说：看，我要把你赶出地面；今年你必要死，因为你说了背叛上主的话。”

text_en: In that same year, in the seventh month, the prophet Hananiah died.
text_cn: 哈纳尼雅先知就死在那年七月。
